### Accessibility and behavior

- A real heading element follows as/level with default h2
- Subtitle and metadata remain visible beside the heading

### Compatibility

Mirrors renderDetailHeader title/subtitle/metadata aliases and headingTag(level, 2); saved-schema as selects a heading element, and authored default-slot content is preserved. Saved-schema titleField and subtitleField lower to title and subtitle, and an integer headingLevel lowers to level; none of the three is a public prop.
